name: hexy-ground
prompt: Hand-painted detailed anime cartoon matching the attached reference, same youthful round face, oversized eyes, clothing and proportions. TRUE transparent alpha background, no gradient, haze, checkers, text or labels. Every drawing isolated with generous empty transparent gutters and 40px transparent outer margins. Complete hats, hair, hands, feet and wands inside each cell. Not a redesign, not an adult version. Chronological cel animation with visible controlled motion of hair, hat cloth, sleeves, chest breathing and hands, not duplicated stills. Keep silhouette scale, face identity, costume and prop length consistent. CRITICAL ANATOMY: exactly TWO arms total, TWO shoulders with exactly TWO short sleeves, TWO elbows, TWO wrists, TWO hands. Each hand connected to its own distinct shoulder by one upper arm and one forearm. Do not draw a spare hand, floating fingers, a third forearm, forked elbow, duplicate skin strip or disembodied arm. In the TWO-HAND pose, both hands grip the SAME BLACK WAND HANDLE: right hand higher, left hand lower directly below it; right elbow raised outward, left elbow bent near chest. Clearly separated elbows and continuous arms, no crossing forearms that create a third limb. The left hand never grasps a ghost forearm. Exactly ONE star wand. Aim the wand diagonally UPPER RIGHT at 45 degrees throughout. Hat blue with yellow star, pink hair, white sailor blouse with navy cuffs, red bow, navy pleated skirt, blue knee socks, black buckle shoes. Wide forceful pink hair streams LEFT. Fully clothed. Create EXACTLY TWENTY drawings arranged in FOUR columns and FIVE rows, one acting group per row. ROW1: focused controlled resistance, mouth closed, RIGHT hand alone grips the wand, LEFT hand clenched visibly near waist; four distinct wind/breathing phases. ROW2: genuine sudden SURPRISE, eyes widen and mouth parts, shoulders recoil, LEFT hand moves from waist toward the wand lower handle over four consecutive drawings; right hand never lets go. ROW3: four consecutive transition drawings finishing the LEFT hand's grip directly BELOW the right hand on the handle, both elbows separated, teeth clenching, shoulders and body leaning away from pressure. ROW4: four looping frames of MAXIMUM STRAIN with BOTH HANDS on the wand, gritted teeth visible, one sweat bead, brow furrow, elbows trembling and clothing/hair whipping left, effort not a happy expression. ROW5: four looping TWO-HAND RALLY frames, determined eyes and clenched teeth with renewed strength, torso pushing forward, pink reflected light, not a smile. Every row flows coherently into the next. FULL BODY game sprites. Feet on same ground baseline in a very wide braced stance. As pressure grows, bend knees and shift weight to back foot, boots remain planted. Four columns, five rows, generous canvas size for twenty complete full bodies.
